capabilities: Generate dated markdown notes summarizing Oura sleep, heart-rate and activity metrics for 7, 14, or 28-day windows
Compare each metric against the prior three weeks' mean and SD, including outlier flags beyond 1.5 SD
Connect to Oura through OAuth from the plugin settings
Configure output folder, default window, deviation threshold and the prompt template that leads each note
Run the same summary generation headless through a CLI for automation
extras: The OAuth access token is stored in plaintext in plugin data and syncs with the vault if the vault syncs to a cloud service; it expires after 30 days and requires reconnecting. The plugin changed to OAuth in 0.2.0 after Oura retired personal access tokens, deleting the old token setting on first load. A headless CLI in the separate petrograph repo reuses the plugin's generation code.
intentEvidence: A companion to Microlite (Obsidian plugin link), which does the same for your note edits.
motivation: Oura's app shows only today, so the author built a note that reports each metric's change against the wearer's own recent baseline, keeping the field set small so a language model is not buried in noise.
problem: Oura's own app shows only the current day, and there is no built-in way to bring ring data into Obsidian as a compact summary prepared for an LLM.

relations.evidence: A companion to Microlite (Obsidian plugin link), which does the same for your note edits.

requires.name: Oura OAuth client ID from a self-registered application

summary: Generates an LLM-ready markdown note summarizing Oura sleep, heart-rate and activity metrics for 7, 14, or 28 days against a three-week baseline.
